context: Two teens discuss favorite anime and shows
purpose: Teach: アニメーション/楽曲/魔女/テレビ局/サロン/お笑い/中核/ソング

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、昨日のアニメ見た?オープニングのアニメーションがめっちゃ綺麗で鳥肌立ったんだけど。
lines.en: Hey, did you watch the anime yesterday? The opening animation was so gorgeous it gave me chills.
lines.style: Excited teen girl chatting casually with friend

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 見た見た!主人公の魔女、可愛すぎない?もう完全に俺の推しになったわ。
lines.en: I watched it! The witch protagonist is way too cute. She's totally my favorite now.
lines.style: Enthusiastic teen boy responding with casual slang

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかる〜。あのテレビ局、深夜にいつも神アニメ流してくれるよね。マジで神。
lines.en: I know right. That TV station always airs amazing anime late at night. They're the best.
lines.style: Agreeing teen girl gushing about shared interests

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そうそう。あ、こないだ友達と入ったカフェでさ、BGMがそのアニメの楽曲ばっかでウケたんだよ。
lines.en: Right. Oh, the other day at a cafe with friends, the BGM was all that anime's tracks. So funny.
lines.style: Teen boy shifting topic with funny anecdote casually

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ウケる(笑)。あ、昨日のお笑い番組も見た?ゲストにあの声優さん出てたよ。
lines.en: That's hilarious. Oh, did you see the comedy show yesterday? That voice actor was a guest.
lines.style: Laughing teen girl bringing up another favorite program

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで?録画しとけばよかった…。あの人、最近のヒット作で中核メンバー演じてるよね。
lines.en: Seriously? I should've recorded it. They're playing a core member in a recent hit show.
lines.style: Regretful teen boy with knowledgeable fan commentary

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それな。エンディングのソングも歌ってるらしくて、私もう毎日リピートしてる。
lines.en: Exactly. Apparently they sing the ending song too. I'm replaying it every single day.
lines.style: Devoted teen fangirl sharing daily listening habit

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ今度カラオケ行って一緒に歌おうぜ。帰りに新しくできたサロンも寄って髪セットしよ。
lines.en: Let's hit karaoke and sing it together. On the way back, stop at the new salon for a hair set.
lines.style: Friendly teen boy proposing a fun plan together
